items.title: 6.12.1 Reaction ke liye delta G ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.12.1, printed pages 139-140.

blocks.text: Sample Problem 6.12: calcium sulfate ka halna

25 degrees C par CaSO4(s) se Ca2+(aq) + SO4 2-(aq) ke liye, heats of formation CaSO4(s) -1432.7, Ca2+(aq) -543.0 aur SO4 2-(aq) -907.5 kJ, aur standard entropies 106.7, -55.2 aur +17.2 J fi K ke saath: delta H = (-543.0 - 907.5) - (-1432.7) = -17.8 kJ; delta S = (-55.2 + 17.2) - 106.7 = -144.7 J fi K = -0.1447 kJ fi K (print '-1447 J/K' likhti hai); delta G = delta H - T delta S = -17.8 - 298 x (-0.1447) = +25.3 kJ. Amal 25 degrees C par standard halaat mein khud-ba-khud nahi.

25 degrees C par N2(g) + 3H2(g) se 2NH3(g) ke liye, heats of formation N2 0, H2 0 aur NH3 -45.9 kJ, aur standard entropies 191.5, 130.6 aur 193 J fi K ke saath: delta H = 2 x (-45.9) - 0 = -91.8 kJ; delta S = 2 x 193 - (191.5 + 3 x 130.6) = -197 J fi K = -0.197 kJ fi K; delta G = -91.8 - 298 x (-0.197) = -33.1 kJ. Kyunke delta G manfi hai, Haber process standard halaat, 25 degrees C, par khud-ba-khud hai.

blocks.prompt: Oopar ki dono reactions exothermic hain aur manfi entropy tabdeeliyon ke saath. Ek khud-ba-khud aur doosri kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Delta H aur delta S dono manfi hon to delta G sirf tab manfi hai jab T delta S term delta H se chhoti ho. Haber process ke liye 298 x 0.197 = 58.7 kJ 91.8 se kam hai, to delta G manfi; calcium sulfate ke liye 298 x 0.1447 = 43.1 kJ 17.8 se zyada hai, to delta G musbat. Doosri soorat mein entropy ka nuqsan chhoti hararat ki kharij par ghalib hai.

items: Delta G = delta H - T delta S, delta H heats of formation se aur delta S standard entropies se (J ko kJ mein badlein): CaSO4 halna +25.3 kJ, khud-ba-khud nahi; Haber process -33.1 kJ, 25 degrees C par khud-ba-khud.
